_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

A Journey Further#003.src: {u}, good news. I'm basically as recovered as I think I'll get.
A Journey Further#003.dst: {u}、いい知らせだ。もうこれ以上は望めないくらい回復した。

A Journey Further#004.src: >and the hero shall blind the ancient seer. good luck.
A Journey Further#004.dst: >そして英雄は古の予言者の目をくらます。幸運を。

A Journey Further#005.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の {p} で Aledar と話す。

A Journey Further#006.src: Alright, let's go. I'll tell you more about our journey on the way.
A Journey Further#006.dst: よし、行こう。道すがら、この旅のことをもっと話すよ。
A Journey Further#006.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#008.src: We should try to follow the path as closely as we can. You lead, I'll follow.
A Journey Further#008.dst: できるだけ道に沿って進もう。君が先導して、僕が続く。
A Journey Further#008.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#010.dst: 止まれ！ 今の聞こえた？
A Journey Further#010.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#011.dst: 待ち伏せだ！ 気を抜くな、{u}！
A Journey Further#011.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#013.src: Good work. Seems that killing the king made the other creatures run off. We’re lucky about that-
A Journey Further#013.dst: よくやった。王を倒したら他の奴らは逃げたみたいだ。運がよかった―
A Journey Further#013.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#014.src: Wait, {u}, what's going on? Are you alright?
A Journey Further#014.dst: 待って、{u}、どうした？ 大丈夫か？
A Journey Further#014.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#015.src: Oh, no no! I have a potion for this, where is it, where is it, aha! Here, drink!
A Journey Further#015.dst: ああ、だめだめ！ これに効く薬がある、どこだ、どこだ、あった！ ほら、飲んで！
A Journey Further#015.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#016.src: One of those things must have infected your wounds... Everything in this area looks completely hazardous and sickening.
A Journey Further#016.dst: あいつらに傷口から感染させられたんだ…この辺りは何もかも危険で気分が悪くなる。
A Journey Further#016.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#017.src: I expected the worst, so I tried to bring anything and everything that might help. Let's keep moving.
A Journey Further#017.dst: 最悪を想定して、役に立ちそうな物は全部持ってきたんだ。先へ進もう。
A Journey Further#017.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#018.src: Continue on the main path with Aledar.
A Journey Further#018.dst: Aledar と本道を進み続ける。

A Journey Further#021.src: I'm... I'm going to lead us for now. At least for a little...while... I can't have you g-getting-
A Journey Further#021.dst: 僕が…しばらく先導するよ。少しの…間だけでも…君をまた、き、傷つけ―
A Journey Further#021.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#023.src: ...urgh... I...sorry. I just... I need a moment.
A Journey Further#023.dst: …うう…僕は…ごめん。ちょっと…少し休ませて。
A Journey Further#023.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#024.src: {u}, you just... you have to realize, I can't have you getting hurt.
A Journey Further#024.dst: {u}、君は…わかってほしい。君を傷つけさせるわけにはいかないんだ。
A Journey Further#024.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#025.src: I want to stress this... We NEED to get to the end of this path, together.
A Journey Further#025.dst: 念を押しておく…僕らは一緒にこの道の果てへ行かなきゃならない。
A Journey Further#025.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#027.src: Okay. I'm as good as I can get right now. Let's move.
A Journey Further#027.dst: よし。今はこれが精一杯だ。行こう。
A Journey Further#027.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#028.src: Ah? What... What just... Why do I...
A Journey Further#028.dst: え？ 何…今のは…どうして僕は…
A Journey Further#028.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#029.src: I'll be fine, I just...why did I feel so empty all of the sudden...?
A Journey Further#029.dst: 大丈夫、ただ…なぜ急にこんなに空っぽな気がしたんだろう…？
A Journey Further#029.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#030.src: A mysterious force pushes you back...
A Journey Further#030.dst: 謎の力に押し戻された…

A Journey Further#031.src: Oh no, I think something is coming... {u}! Fight it off, I don't think I can defend myself right now!
A Journey Further#031.dst: まずい、何か来る…{u}！ 追い払ってくれ、今の僕じゃ身を守れない！
A Journey Further#031.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#032.src: Defend Aledar from the Radiated Spiders.
A Journey Further#032.dst: Radiated Spider から Aledar を守る。

A Journey Further#033.src: Huff... Not feeling totally better, but... At least I can still defend myself.
A Journey Further#033.dst: はあ…まだ本調子じゃないけど…少なくとも自分の身は守れる。
A Journey Further#033.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#034.src: My stomach is empty, I can't even vomit... Why so I still feel so dizzy? Maybe a potion will help...
A Journey Further#034.dst: 胃が空っぽで吐くこともできない…なぜまだこんなに目が回るんだ？ 薬が効くかも…
A Journey Further#034.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#035.dst: うーん。いや、これじゃない…
A Journey Further#035.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#036.src: Urgh, pfft! My vomit tasted better than that coming up...
A Journey Further#036.dst: うえっ、ぺっ！ 吐いた物のほうがまだマシな味だった…
A Journey Further#036.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#037.src: Hah...that's the ticket. Which potion was this anyways... ... hair loss treatment? Why did THAT work?
A Journey Further#037.dst: はあ…これだ。ところで何の薬だったんだ…育毛剤？ なんでそれが効くんだ？
A Journey Further#037.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#038.src: Though, you saw what happened to that beast I attacked? Follow me.
A Journey Further#038.dst: ところで、僕が攻撃したあの獣がどうなったか見た？ ついてきて。
A Journey Further#038.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#039.src: This, from what I recall of the mission statements, is referred to as a "Void Hole." It's a sort of portal.
A Journey Further#039.dst: 任務の資料によると、これは「虚無の穴」と呼ばれている。一種のポータルだ。
A Journey Further#039.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#040.src: They connect to each other in odd ways, but we saw the beast come out of that one when I knocked it in, so...
A Journey Further#040.dst: 妙な形でつながってるけど、僕が叩き込んだ獣はあっちから出てきた。だから…
A Journey Further#040.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#041.src: Watch. I'll come out the other side.
A Journey Further#041.dst: 見てて。反対側から出てくる。
A Journey Further#041.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#042.src: Alright, good! It does connect up consistently, at least. You try now.
A Journey Further#042.dst: よし、いいぞ！ 少なくとも出口は毎回同じだ。今度は君がやってみて。
A Journey Further#042.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#043.dst: 虚無の穴 に飛び込む。

A Journey Further#044.src: Continue on the trail with Aledar.
A Journey Further#044.dst: Aledar と小道を進み続ける。

A Journey Further#045.src: I bring this up because if we're seeing one, we'll be seeing more soon. You'll need to adjust yourself to the sight of them.
A Journey Further#045.dst: こんな話をするのは、一つ見かけたらすぐにもっと出てくるからだ。見慣れておいたほうがいい。
A Journey Further#045.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#047.src: We grossly underestimated the difficulties we would have here. And, by that, I mean myself, Elphie, and Lucio did...
A Journey Further#047.dst: ここの困難をひどく甘く見ていた。僕らというのは、僕と Elphie と Lucio のことだ…
A Journey Further#047.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#048.src: We were each unprepared and cocky. If it weren't for you, I'd be dead now, for what it's worth.
A Journey Further#048.dst: みんな準備不足でうぬぼれていた。君がいなければ、今ごろ僕は死んでいただろう。
A Journey Further#048.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#049.src: I wasn't certain at first about you coming along, but you've more than shown you were the right one for the job.
A Journey Further#049.dst: 最初は君が来ることに確信がなかった。でも、君こそ適任だと十分すぎるほど示してくれた。
A Journey Further#049.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#050.src: ...I had to figure this map was outdated. This wall of spikes isn't listed on it, and the path goes through here!
A Journey Further#050.dst: …この地図は古いと思うべきだった。このトゲの壁は載ってないのに、道はここを通ってる！
A Journey Further#050.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#051.src: I'll have to assume they're new...and if they're new, I might be able to bash through them.
A Journey Further#051.dst: 新しくできたと考えるしかない…新しいなら、叩き壊せるかもしれない。
A Journey Further#051.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#052.src: {u}, try throwing a spell at the same time! Let's crack through these things!
A Journey Further#052.dst: {u}、同時に呪文を撃ってみて！ こいつを突き破ろう！
A Journey Further#052.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#054.src: ...aagh... I... H-how are these so resilient...?
A Journey Further#054.dst: …ぐっ…僕は…な、なんでこんなに硬いんだ…？
A Journey Further#054.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#055.src: I'm an idiot... I nearly killed myself trying that. I nearly ruined the mission...
A Journey Further#055.dst: 僕はバカだ…あんなことして死ぬところだった。任務を台無しにするところだった…
A Journey Further#055.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#056.src: I'm sorry, but you'll have to go without me. I can't move another step for now.
A Journey Further#056.dst: すまない、ここからは一人で行ってくれ。今はもう一歩も動けない。
A Journey Further#056.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#057.src: There's a lot of void holes around here, remember my warning... You can probably get past these spikes with one.
A Journey Further#057.dst: この辺りには 虚無の穴 がたくさんある。警告を忘れないで…それでトゲを越えられるかもしれない。
A Journey Further#057.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#058.src: If I'd been thinking I would have suggested it earlier... Once you're past, we'll...uh. We'll do something.
A Journey Further#058.dst: もっと早く思いつけばよかった…君が越えたら、僕らは…ええと。何とかしよう。
A Journey Further#058.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#059.src: Just...be careful where you go. The void holes could lead anywhere. They might lead you someplace very, very dangerous, too dangerous even for you. I pray they won't...
A Journey Further#059.dst: ただ…行き先には気をつけて。虚無の穴 はどこに通じているかわからない。とても、とても危険な場所…君でも手に負えない所に出るかもしれない。そうならないよう祈ってる…
A Journey Further#059.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#060.src: There's a void hole right there to try out first. Get going, now. You have to do this.
A Journey Further#060.dst: すぐそこに 虚無の穴 がある、まずそれを試して。さあ行って。君がやるしかないんだ。
A Journey Further#060.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#061.src: Use Void Holes to try and get behind the spike barrier
A Journey Further#061.dst: 虚無の穴 を使ってトゲの障壁の裏側へ回り込む

A Journey Further#062.src: Find a way to help Aledar get to the other side of the spike barrier.
A Journey Further#062.dst: Aledar がトゲの障壁の反対側へ行ける方法を探す。

A Journey Further#063.src: ...wait, {u}? You got to the other side then...? Good...
A Journey Further#063.dst: …待って、{u}？ 向こう側に行けたのか…？ よかった…
A Journey Further#063.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#064.src: I don't know what you did, but whatever it was, it's made cracks in the spikes that I can see from this side.
A Journey Further#064.dst: 何をしたのかわからないけど、とにかくトゲにひびが入って、こっちからも見える。
A Journey Further#064.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#065.src: I've got some of my energy back...let's try spellcasting again. If we do it at the same time, we might make some headway.
A Journey Further#065.dst: 力が少し戻った…もう一度呪文を試そう。同時に撃てば、突破口が開けるかもしれない。
A Journey Further#065.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#066.src: I won't crack my skull open on the spikes again though. Promise.
A Journey Further#066.dst: でも、もう頭をトゲに打ちつけたりはしないよ。約束する。
A Journey Further#066.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#067.src: You lead. I'll cast my spell as soon as I hear yours.
A Journey Further#067.dst: 先にやって。君の呪文が聞こえたらすぐ僕も撃つ。
A Journey Further#067.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#068.src: Thank god it worked... That's our destination there, the Eldritch Outlook.
A Journey Further#068.dst: よかった、うまくいった……あそこが目的地、異形の展望台だ。
A Journey Further#068.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#069.src: Now comes the hardest part... Come along. I'll need you there for it.
A Journey Further#069.dst: ここからが一番つらいところだ…来てくれ。君にいてもらう必要がある。
A Journey Further#069.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#070.src: That blade there...it's made for sacrifice. See how that gate is shut?
A Journey Further#070.dst: あそこの刃…あれは生贄のためのものだ。あの門が閉じているだろう？
A Journey Further#070.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#071.src: In order to open the doors to the Outlook, we need to sacrifice a powerful soul.
A Journey Further#071.dst: Outlook への扉を開くには、強い魂を生贄に捧げる必要がある。
A Journey Further#071.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#072.src: We... we should have told you from the start. You and Lucio. Elphie and I, we knew. We knew this would be here.
A Journey Further#072.dst: 僕ら…最初から話すべきだった。君と Lucio に。Elphie と僕は知っていた。ここにこれがあると。
A Journey Further#072.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#073.src: We didn't have... we didn't have a sacrifice in mind. We decided that it would be best decided once we reached that point. And I think we both knew it would have to be one of us.
A Journey Further#073.dst: 僕らは…誰を生贄にするか決めていなかった。ここに着いてから決めるのが一番だと話し合った。そして二人とも、僕らのどちらかになるとわかっていたと思う。
A Journey Further#073.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#074.src: ...I think she would have insisted it be her. Even though both of us had something we would be le-...
A Journey Further#074.dst: …彼女なら自分がやると言い張っただろうな。二人とも残していくものがあったのに…
A Journey Further#074.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#075.src: It doesn't matter now. It's just us left. And I've been mulling it over since we got to the town... you'll sacrifice me. I won't take no for an answer.
A Journey Further#075.dst: もうどうでもいい。残ったのは僕らだけだ。町に着いてからずっと考えていた…君が僕を生贄にするんだ。反論は受けつけない。
A Journey Further#075.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#076.src: I mean... look at the state I'm in, {u}! I'm on death's door already, and you've proven yourself far stronger than I am even at my best.
A Journey Further#076.dst: だって…今の僕の有様を見てくれ、{u}！ もう死にかけてるし、君は万全の僕よりずっと強いと証明した。
A Journey Further#076.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#077.src: Here. You can take everything I had on me. My emeralds, and the key to the dungeon. I certainly won't be able to use them anymore.
A Journey Further#077.dst: ほら。僕の持ち物を全部持っていって。エメラルドと、ダンジョンの鍵だ。僕にはもう使えないからね。
A Journey Further#077.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#078.src: Upon the top of the tower is... Well, something. We don't know for certain what it is, but it will prevent you from passing through.
A Journey Further#078.dst: 塔の頂上には…何かがいる。正体ははっきりしないけど、そいつが君の行く手を阻むはずだ。
A Journey Further#078.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#079.src: You'll have to kill it to break the barrier. But... find other soldiers who can help you. It will be impossible to defeat alone.
A Journey Further#079.dst: 障壁を破るにはそいつを倒すしかない。でも…手を貸してくれる兵士を探して。一人じゃ絶対に勝てない。
A Journey Further#079.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#080.src: ...no more putting it off, then. I'm bleeding out.
A Journey Further#080.dst: …じゃあ、もう先延ばしはやめよう。血が止まらないんだ。
A Journey Further#080.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#082.src: Right click to grab the blade in the altar.
A Journey Further#082.dst: 右クリックで祭壇の刃を手に取る。

A Journey Further#083.src: Now...strike me down. My soul will unlock the gate...
A Journey Further#083.dst: さあ…僕を斬ってくれ。僕の魂が門を開く…
A Journey Further#083.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#086.src: You...can do this. I know y-you can.
A Journey Further#086.dst: 君なら…できる。わかってる、き、君なら。
A Journey Further#086.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#088.dst: 僕らを、み、見ている怪物を…
A Journey Further#088.speaker: Aledar
